data.description:
## Problem
The relationships query was fixed to work for sprints (commit a0e979c8), but the fix is incomplete:

### Missing Entity Types
Current `_get_entity_node()` only handles:
- T-* (tasks)
- S-* (sprints)  
- D-* (decisions)
- EPIC-* (epics)

Missing:
- H-* (handoffs)
- Any future entity types

### Missing Edge Types
Current `get_all_relationships()` only handles:
- BLOCKS
- DEPENDS_ON
- CONTAINS

Missing (26 types!):
- REQUIRES, ENABLES, CONFLICTS, SUPPORTS, REFUTES, SIMILAR, CONTRADICTS
- PRECEDES, TRIGGERS
- ANSWERS, RAISES, EXPLORES, OBSERVES, SUGGESTS
- IMPLEMENTS, TESTS, REFINES, MOTIVATES, JUSTIFIES, CAUSED_BY
- HAS_OPTION, HAS_ASPECT, PART_OF

## Proposed Solution
1. Make `_get_entity_node()` discover entity types dynamically:
   - Use entity prefix → getter mapping from a registry
   - Or try all registered getters
   
2. Make edge type handling dynamic:
   - Return dict with ALL edge types as keys
   - Dynamically group by edge type rather than hardcoding
   - Example: `{'BLOCKS': [...], 'DEPENDS_ON': [...], 'IMPLEMENTS': [...], ...}`

3. Add extensibility:
   - New entity types auto-discovered via ID prefix
   - New edge types auto-included in results

## Implementation Hints
- Look at EdgeType enum for all edge types
- Consider grouping results by edge direction (outgoing/incoming) AND type
- Maybe return: `{'outgoing': {'BLOCKS': [...], 'CONTAINS': [...]}, 'incoming': {...}}`

## Files to Modify
- scripts/got_utils.py: `_get_entity_node()`, `get_all_relationships()`

## Guardrails
- DO: Maintain backward compatibility with existing result structure
- DO: Add new keys for new edge types (don't remove existing keys)
- DO: Handle unknown entity types gracefully (return None, don't crash)
- DO NOT: Require code changes when new edge types are added

properties.retrospective: Completed in commit b45833b6. All 29 edge types now handled dynamically with proper grammatical conjugation for incoming edges.

data.title: Make GoT relationships query fully generic for all entity and edge types
